title: Mirai_Botnet_Investigation_485
description: Investigate unusual traffic patterns and potential unauthorized access in a network compromised by the Mirai botnet.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential unauthorized access. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the sandbox via SSH using the username 'user' and password 'Mirai2023!'. Enter 'start' to begin.
levels.local_content: Access the sandbox via SSH using the username 'user' and password 'Mirai2023!'. Enter 'start' to begin.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication. Enumerate running services and identify beaconing behavior associated with botnet activity.
levels.solution: Check running services and their network connections. Look for services that communicate with external hosts, particularly those that match the behavior of the Mirai botnet.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and their network connections.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services that communicate with external hosts.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The suspicious service is likely a timer service related to botnet activity.

levels.title: Identify Abnormal Traffic Service
levels.content: Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic. Distinguish malicious traffic generation services from legitimate network services.
levels.solution: Examine network traffic patterns and service logs. Look for services that generate excessive traffic, particularly those that match the behavior of the Mirai botnet.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine network traffic patterns and service logs.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services that generate excessive traffic.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The abnormal traffic service is likely a timer service related to botnet flooding activity.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot. Identify persistence mechanisms (e.g., systemd, cron, scheduled task, registry).
levels.solution: Investigate system startup configurations and scheduled tasks. Look for services that are set to start automatically, particularly those that match the behavior of the Mirai botnet.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate system startup configurations and scheduled tasks.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services that are set to start automatically.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The persistence mechanism is likely a systemd timer service.
